title: Express Interior Design Package — €20/m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Fast interior design from 14 days: layout, furniture plan and choice of materials. €20/m², from €1,500. Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: The “Express” design package — fast interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: The “Express” design package — fast interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: “Express” is a quick interior concept for an apartment, house, or commercial space: a measured floor plan, a furniture layout, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of the main rooms.
You see the layout, the combination of materials, the furniture, lighting, and color before finishing work even begins.

The package is designed for properties where the construction and engineering solutions have already been decided. It does not include a full set of working drawings, and electrical design is charged separately.
Before design work begins, we record the room dimensions and the positions of walls, windows, door openings, and utilities.
The layout and 3D visualizations are based on this plan.
We place the furniture and main interior elements on the plan.
We take into account the room dimensions, walkways, ergonomics, storage, and how you will use the space every day.
We create photorealistic 3D visualizations for each main room.
They show the furniture, finishing materials, lighting, colors, textiles, and decor.
The package includes one full round of revisions to the concept.

blocks.text: A fast design project without unnecessary documentation

parts.html: The main advantage of “Express” is speed. Turnaround time: from 14 days after the layout is approved.

Unlike the more complete packages, this one does not include a full set of construction and engineering drawings: the work focuses on the layout, the furniture arrangement, and how the interior looks.
This is convenient if the engineering solutions have already been developed, the renovation follows existing documentation, or you primarily need a visual concept.
Apartments in new developments and existing buildings, private houses, condos, investment properties, offices, small stores, beauty salons, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.
If, before finishing work begins, you need to quickly settle on the furniture arrangement and overall style, choose a combination of materials and colors, and see the interior in 3D visualizations.
It works both for your own home and for investment properties that need to be ready for rent or sale quickly.
An interior concept: a measured floor plan, a furniture layout, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of the main rooms.
You know in advance what the property will look like, which materials and colors to use, and where the furniture will go.
€20/m²
Minimum package price: €1,500.
The final cost depends on the floor area, the number of rooms, and the complexity of the property.
Turnaround time: from 14 days after the layout is approved.

blocks.text: What’s not included in the “Express” package

parts.html: A full set of working drawings for the construction crew is not included in the package. Electrical design is charged separately.
If you need demolition and construction plans, electrical, lighting, plumbing, ceiling, and floor plans, as well as wall elevations, choose the “Basic” package (€35–45/m²).

“Express” can be supplemented with individual technical drawings, electrical, lighting, and plumbing design, custom furniture design with furniture drawings, a renovation cost estimate, design supervision, furnishing and procurement, furniture manufacturing and installation, and a turnkey renovation.
You can start with a quick concept and expand the project at later stages.

blocks.text: Interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs residential and commercial interiors, makes custom furniture, and sees projects through to completion.
We work in Bratislava and Vienna, and design projects for other cities in Europe and the USA are done remotely.

If you need to settle on a layout and style quickly, “Express” gives you a finished concept without extra documentation. The floor area and goals for the property can be discussed at a free consultation.
